description: Runs one Siro resource and pays its exact USD price over x402, in USDG on Robinhood Chain or USDC on Solana, Base, Arbitrum or Polygon. Send a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]; without it the tool returns isError with the payment requirements (price, networks, payTo) to sign. The work runs before the payment settles, so failed calls are never charged; a successful call returns the result plus a receipt with the transaction hash in _meta["x402/payment-response"]. Agents without an x402 wallet can use the Siro CLI (`siro mcp`), which pays automatically within spending caps.

input.description: Input object matching the resource's schema from siro_resource_schema, e.g. {"network":"base"}.

name: siro_call
title: Run a paid tool (x402)
